about_the_game:
An Epic Linear Journey

This RPG boasts a vast world, offering a traditional, linear experience that allows players to fully immerse themselves in the story. Set in a single timeline, the sudden discovery of an Ancient God's Scroll forces you, the protagonist, to experience a shift in the landscape and embark on an adventure across the continent with your companions. Through your adventure, you'll gradually uncover the story of the Four Continents, the Eight Generals, and the Academy Scroll, while also experiencing the emotions and transformations of the protagonists. If you enjoy traditional, linear, turn-based RPGs, embark on this epic journey!

Easy-to-understand Original Skill Classification

To align with the story, skills have been redesigned to include Guigu Magic, corresponding to attack magic, support magic, and ultimate attacks. As a key feature, you'll gain access to more powerful skills as you progress.

Pixel Art Reminiscent of Nostalgia

To better illustrate the geographical features of the story, I've personally created over a hundred maps over the nearly three years since I began developing the game. Each region boasts its own unique character, perfectly capturing the story. During gameplay, you'll also enjoy the visual feast of flat art, offering a traditional, authentic RPG experience without the added 3D enhancements or enhancements.

More Fun

To ensure the game's interactions aren't limited to traditional turn-based combat, simple puzzles add a layer of fun. These puzzles aren't tedious or time-consuming; they simply add to the interactive experience. Of course, the encounters revolve around the story itself.

An Immersive Emotional Story

The story is the most crucial aspect of this game. The script has been the product of over a decade of careful refinement, and the text volume is immense. Over ten documents were created just to build the story structure. While I can't fully portray every character in this game, the linear progression of the protagonist will inadvertently deepen your impressions of some. If you have more ideas for characters, please leave me a message so I can provide more creative ideas and thoughts for future sequels to this story.

An independent work committed to originality

With the advancement of AI technology, originality has become increasingly unpopular. But I still insist on writing my own stories. Every character, every name, every skill, even every poem, is my own creation. So players can fully enjoy the story and experience its real souls.

Some are brave, some are clever, some are silly, but all are logical. If you are lucky enough to have them as your friends, embark on this journey and become whoever you will be!
